title: Don't do it. Destroyed my floor
text: Don't do it. Destroyed my floor. I would give this 0 stars if I could. The center beam keeps popping out of place and has destroyed my laminate floors. 30 days and broke. They still had the nerve to charge me returning shipping.

product_metadata.title: Essential Faux Leather Upholstered Platform Bed Frame / Mattress Foundation / no Boxspring needed / Wooden Slat Support, King
features: Platform style frame is padded and upholstered in faux leather
Strong mattress support prevents sagging and increases mattress life
description: The Essential Platform Bed by Zinus is a minimalistic, stylish bed base that works well with a variety of decorating styles and lets you easily update the look of your room. Top-quality faux leather in espresso covers this platform bed frame. A box spring is not necessary with the Essential Platform Bed as wooden slats provide strong level, support for your memory foam, latex, or spring mattress. The center metal rail and center legs add additional support. The Essential Faux Leather Platform Bed by Zinus provides stylish and strong support for your mattress. Mattress not included.
